quest.title: A Gifted Rose: Some People Never Fade Away
quest.description: Join others to witness the Golden Rose in full bloom.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Delicious Butter Chicken x1, Delicious Shawarma Wrap x2, Glabrous Beans x2

dialogues.speaker: Affan
dialogues.text: I was about to lose hope. Didn't expect this flower to actually grow. I guess as long as we're alive, wonderful things can still happen to us.

dialogues.speaker: Affan
dialogues.text: Little one, are you still sad about Uncle Shafaqat? Don't worry. The living have to carry on with the wishes of those who passed away. We can't let them down.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: Mr. Affan... I'm not so young anymore. Those friends I grew up with... their kids must be old enough now to go buy spices at the store.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: But I agree. Since we're alive, we may as well try our best to live a happy life.

dialogues.speaker: Affan
dialogues.text: It's you guys. Well then, we and the roses have all been waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sabbah came early too!

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: I've been coming here a lot lately, and I've read the notes that Mr. Shafaqat left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: I used to feel lonely staying in Aaru Village, but I feel differently now.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: At least I'm not completely alone. I have these roses, the memories of being with you guys, and Mr. Affan.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: I still have some good things in my life, and just thinking of that makes me feel less lonely.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: Mr. Affan and I have had a discussion. I will help him tend to the Golden Roses from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: We'll cultivate more of them till they fill the whole nursery. But for now, let's get these to bloom.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: Do you remember how you made my Sumeru Roses bloom? Let's use the same method.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let us help.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: Okay, it's up to you now.

talks.objective: Use the power of Dendro to "awaken" the Golden Rose
Use the power of Dendro to "awaken" the Golden Rose

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Rose, oh roses, grant me my wish."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Blooming from the stone, the Golden Rose sang to me."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Golden Roses really are beautiful. Seeing them bloom has really brightened Paimon's day!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These days of hard work were not in vain. Paimon's so happy!

choices.text: The wish has finally been fulfilled.

response.speaker: Affan
response.text: I finally did something right in the end. Uncle Shafaqat, I've helped you fulfill your wish.

response.speaker: Sabbah
response.text: It's a shame he is no longer around to see it.

response.speaker: Affan
response.text: Don't say that, Sabbah. Do you remember the last stanza of the rose song?

response.speaker: Affan
response.text: "No land but folk songs bore my spirit."

response.speaker: Affan
response.text: "Songs shall defy my fate, and overcome my destiny."

response.speaker: Affan
response.text: "They will surpass me, surpass time. They will surpass the ever-lasting withering of life."

response.speaker: Affan
response.text: Uncle Shafaqat's life, the Golden Roses, and the folk song he composed himself — they have all remained with us.

response.speaker: Sabbah
response.text: Yeah, you're right. He has surpassed time and the withering of life.

response.speaker: Sabbah
response.text: Thank you for telling me about him. This means a lot to me.

response.speaker: Sabbah
response.text: He was an exile before me, and seeing the traces of his life here always makes me feel like I've crossed through time and space...

response.speaker: Sabbah
response.text: I'm not just looking at him. I'm looking at myself too.

response.speaker: Sabbah
response.text: I can no longer say anything to him, but I can shoulder his regrets and live on.

response.speaker: Sabbah
response.text: If I live on for him too, then I'm sure that I will eventually find my own salvation.

response.speaker: Sabbah
response.text: I don't feel so bad living here anymore. I'm... so glad I met you all.

response.speaker: Sabbah
response.text: Roses truly are flowers that can bring people happiness. Mr. Affan, we shall have to work hard and plant more roses here in the future.

response.speaker: Affan
response.text: Hahaha! Well then, you have a deal.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: Use the power of <color=#00E1FFFF>Dendro</color> to awaken the flower sleeping within the shoots.

dialogues.speaker: Affan
dialogues.text: If these few specimens grow well, we will be able to cultivate more Golden Roses.

dialogues.speaker: Affan
dialogues.text: But until then, I think I would feel quite a bit more assured if these few roses bloomed first.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Rose, oh roses, grant me my wish."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Blooming from the stone, the Golden Rose sang to me."
